name: donegate
description: v0.1.20: re-blesses the verdict compile-fail trybuild golden stderr (rustc note-formatting drift only, no contract change). Completion-verification gate for Claude Code: on Stop, run your acceptance commands as subprocesses and block the stop until every required check is green, feeding failures back for an auto-fix loop. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).
